deliveries.formula: D(Q-4) * (1 + g). g = D(Q-1) / D(Q-5) - 1 when D(Q-5) is present and not zero. Otherwise g = 0.
deliveries.notes: Uses the same quarter last year and year-over-year growth from quarters already known at the cutoff. The target quarter's delivery report is not an input. g = 0 only when that year-ago comparison is not in history yet.

automotive_asp.formula: Average of automotive sales revenue divided by deliveries over Q-1, Q-2, Q-3, and Q-4. Drop a quarter with zero deliveries. If none remain, there is no ASP forecast.
automotive_asp.notes: ASP is automotive sales revenue divided by total deliveries. Regulatory credits are not in the numerator.

automotive_sales.formula: Forecast deliveries for Q times forecast ASP for Q.
automotive_sales.notes: No separate trend. Both factors are built only from quarters before Q. A scenario flexes each factor, so the two flexes compound.

regulatory_credits.formula: Average of Q-1 through Q-4, times (1 + g). g = value(Q-1) / value(Q-5) - 1 when value(Q-5) is present and not zero. Otherwise g = 0.
regulatory_credits.notes: Recent run-rate with growth. Scenarios do not flex this line.

leasing.formula: Average of Q-1 through Q-4, times (1 + g). g = value(Q-1) / value(Q-5) - 1 when value(Q-5) is present and not zero. Otherwise g = 0.
leasing.notes: Leasing is its own revenue line. Leased units still sit inside total deliveries, so the volume bar and this line can overlap. Scenarios do not flex this line.

energy.formula: Average of Q-1 through Q-4, times (1 + g). g = value(Q-1) / value(Q-5) - 1 when value(Q-5) is present and not zero. Otherwise g = 0.
energy.notes: Energy generation and storage revenue. Scenarios do not flex this line.

services.formula: Average of Q-1 through Q-4, times (1 + g). g = value(Q-1) / value(Q-5) - 1 when value(Q-5) is present and not zero. Otherwise g = 0.
services.notes: Services and other revenue. Scenarios do not flex this line.

gross_margin.formula: Average margin over Q-1 through Q-4. Use the automotive, energy, and services margins when that segment is in the cutoff history. Otherwise use the total gross margin.
gross_margin.notes: A recent average, with no growth term. The scenario flex adds or subtracts percentage points from this average. It is not a percent of the margin.

operating_expenses.formula: Average of Q-1 through Q-4, times (1 + g). g = value(Q-1) / value(Q-5) - 1 when value(Q-5) is present and not zero. Otherwise g = 0.
operating_expenses.notes: Total operating expenses. R&D and SG&A use the same formula when those series exist. Scenarios do not flex operating expenses.

capex.formula: Average of purchases of property and equipment over Q-1 through Q-4.
capex.notes: Recent run-rate, with no growth term. The amount is positive purchases. Scenarios do not flex capex.

operating_cash_flow.formula: Average of net cash from operating activities over Q-1 through Q-4.
operating_cash_flow.notes: Not a section 4 growth driver. It exists so free cash flow is CFO minus capex. Scenarios do not flex it.

identities.total_revenue: Automotive sales + regulatory credits + leasing + energy + services.
identities.gross_profit: When segment margins are used, each segment's forecast revenue times that segment's forecast margin. Otherwise total revenue times the total forecast margin.
identities.operating_income: Forecast gross profit minus forecast operating expenses.
identities.free_cash_flow: Forecast operating cash flow minus forecast capex.
